# Shanghai HealthFinder (SanEnSheng 优联智康)

> Shanghai HealthFinder helps international visitors and expats compare health
> checkup (physical examination) packages at Shanghai hospitals, and book an
> English-speaking medical escort service for hospital visits.

## What this site offers

- Comparison of health checkup packages across Shanghai hospitals (prices in CNY).
- Hospital directory focused on international departments and private international hospitals.
- English service / English report availability flags for each package (Yes / No / Unknown).
- Medical escort service: an English-speaking escort meets the visitor at their
  hotel, guides them through registration, departments and queues, and takes them
  back. Escorts handle non-medical communication only.
- Prices for quality-assured checkups at Shanghai hospitals typically range from
  ¥6,000 to ¥40,000 depending on the screening content.

## Key pages

- Home (search & compare): https://www.sanensheng.com/
- About the brand & escort service: https://www.sanensheng.com/about
- Compare packages: https://www.sanensheng.com/compare
- Hospital details: https://www.sanensheng.com/hospitals/{id}
- Package details: https://www.sanensheng.com/packages/{id}
- Sitemap: https://www.sanensheng.com/sitemap.xml
- Privacy policy: https://www.sanensheng.com/privacy

## Data access policy

- Anonymous visitors see hospital names + general area, and package names only.
- Full prices, hospital details and package contents require a free registered account.
- Content language: English (brand name includes Chinese 优联智康).

## Contact

- Brand: SanEnSheng (优联智康)
- Website: https://www.sanensheng.com
